name: CompCars
description: Fine-grained car dataset with 431 models and about 214,000 images, including web-nature and surveillance views plus verification annotations. Distinct from Stanford Cars. Data is not vendored; access and use are subject to CUHK terms.
citation: Yang, L., Luo, P., Loy, C. C., & Tang, X. (2015). A Large-Scale Car Dataset for Fine-Grained Categorization and Verification (CompCars). Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).

license.identifier: CUHK terms; not a standard SPDX identifier
